tolerances_mm.circumference_rationale: 1 mm is the acceptance limit for this demonstration. It is about 0.3 to 0.4 percent of these perimeters (235 to 300 mm). The inputs are exact numbers, so the check is tighter than physical tape error on purpose. It still leaves room for kernel tolerance while rejecting a section that missed its target.
tolerances_mm.length_rationale: The proximal face is constructed at z = 0 and the tip point at z = 140. Acceptance uses cutting planes. A non-uniform scale can leave surface poles outside the trimmed solid, so the kernel box is recorded but not used as the check. The last plane that still cuts a curve sits just short of the point tip. 0.05 mm covers that gap.
